answer_1.quote: We evaluate the finetuning of BART-large on the XSum and CNN/DailyMail datasets for text summarization, reporting ROUGE scores.

answer_2.quote: QOFT consistently outperforms LoRA across all tested configurations, while notably utilizing 47-53% fewer trainable parameters. ... QOFT achieves a +0.93 ROUGE-1 on XSum (44.16 vs. 43.23).
